explore-stepup.title: Step it up
explore-stepup.prompt: With 250 primary turns on 120 V, set the secondary to give 240 V.
hints: Twice the voltage needs twice the turns.
explore-stepup.success: 500 turns: a 1 : 2 ratio doubles the voltage.

explore-current.title: Voltage down, current up
explore-current.prompt: 1000 primary turns on 120 V. Set the secondary for 12 V, then compare primary and secondary current.
hints: 12 V is a tenth of 120 V.
explore-current.success: 100 turns: voltage ÷ 10, current × 10. 0.5 A in, 5 A out, 60 W either side.
